title: THE SHADOW
message: Not everything that points somewhere knows the way.
meaning:
The Shadow appears without a visible object capable of casting it. It has direction, shape and apparent intention — but no source.

The card asks whether something that feels like a sign actually deserves to be followed.
imageAlt: A source-less black arrow-shaped shadow crossing the floor of a ruined cathedral
mechanic: ANOMALY direction card. It unlocks SHADOW_ROUTE and may either continue into an unusual branch or return the journey to an earlier visited state.
